scientific_integrity: General proof from Gauss/Salié identities and exact field-trace counting. Full-spectrum FFT checks for seven fields and both sign classes are corroborative, not an infinite proof. No invented provenance or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Odd characteristic, nondegenerate three-variable quadratic form, nonzero radius. Historical priority bounded by inspected papers; unlocated equivalent summations remain possible. No higher-dimensional assertion.
title: Sharp Wiener norms and sparse Fourier kernels of ternary finite-field quadratic shells
